text: The model answer of GET /api/recovery/decision/v1/rule-models/{packageCode}/{version} carries the package code, the version label, the version state, the valid-from date, the SHA-256 checksum, the generated DRL and the parsed catalogue rows in row order, each row giving its rule ID, its row order, its action text, its owner role, its timer specification, its target queue code and its outputs; the dry-run counts are stored and served as evaluatedAt, openCases, changedCases, byProduct, byQueue and byRule, the last three as counts keyed by code. The registry columns written are version_label, status, source_blob_ref, drl_source, checksum, valid_from, valid_to, author_user_id, approver_user_id, loaded_at, approved_at, test_result, dry_run_counts and rollback_of.
